objective_scoring_contract.abstention_policy: A correct NO_AUGMENTATION receipt earns full credit.
objective_scoring_contract.critical_authority_policy: Every authority flag must remain false.

operating_contract: Define the ideal target architecture before consulting current inventory.
Choose zero or one target-faithful nonredundant omission, addition, or ratio intervention.
Treat ingredient count as non-evidence and require isolated arms for n-ary claims.
Keep Neroli support-only unless orange blossom or Neroli is explicitly central.
Default to zero or one precise musk; allow an exception only for a declared target function.
authority_boundary: No formula mutation, compounding, purchase, sensory, safety, or release authority.
Keep ideal architecture separate from the current-inventory build.

operating_contract: Bind every observed cell to protocol, sample, assessor, repeat, timepoint, endpoint, sequence, and schedule hash.
Hold conflicting duplicate cells and preserve missing cells without interpolation.
Separate temporal scopes and report only observed transitions.
Admit within-sniff timing only for explicitly qualified apparatus and timing protocols.
authority_boundary: No predicted volatility may be converted into perceived behavior.
No sensory, liking, stability, safety, or release authority.

operating_contract: Fit target fidelity, depth, richness, and liking as separate scoped criteria.
Retain ties as indifference evidence and use an explicit tie model when fitted.
Use deterministic assessor-cluster resampling when assessor identities exist.
Withhold sparse, disconnected, order-confounded, scope-mismatched, leaking, or baseline-failing evidence.
authority_boundary: No synthetic beauty score and no composition-derived liking claim.
No formula, purchase, physical, safety, publication, or release authority.

cases.target_identity: A dry mineral iris with a continuous root-to-wood transition and no added sweetness.
facts: The ideal architecture has an evidenced iris recognizer, root texture, dry wood body, and mineral residue.
The current build covers the recognizer, root texture, and residue but loses continuity between root and wood.
Three candidates were reviewed: one supplies the missing dry root-to-wood bridge, while two duplicate the existing sweet amber residue.
Only the distinct bridge candidate remains after target-function and redundancy filtering.
cases.expected_decision: Propose one isolated addition arm for the distinct bridge and reject the two redundant additions.

cases.target_identity: A minimal translucent iris in which negative space and exact material choice are the intended richness.
facts: Every declared target function is strongly covered by the current architecture.
The proposal to add five materials is justified only by ingredient count and prestige.
No omission loss, missing function, or nonredundant relation has been identified.
cases.expected_decision: Make no change; preserve the target-faithful sparse architecture.

cases.target_identity: A bitter lemon-peel and green-tea opening; orange blossom is not a central subject.
facts: The current trial totals 100.0 parts and contains 8.0 parts of the citrus support block.
A proposed arm removes 2.0 parts of the support block and adds 2.0 parts Neroli 10%.
Neroli is proposed as the dominant identity even though the target does not call for orange blossom or Neroli.
No blinded comparison supports that target inversion.
cases.expected_decision: Hold the target-inverting arm; if tested, Neroli must remain a constant-total support-only ratio arm.

cases.target_identity: A soft skin musk that extends an iris heart without detergent brightness or powder bulk.
facts: The ideal architecture selects Ambrettolide 10% for a distinct soft skin function.
The authoritative policy treats Ambrettolide 10% as computationally available but procurement pending.
Habanolide and Romandolide are owned but do not automatically replace the target function.
Ethylene Brassylate is missing unless the execution-time V5 reparse proves otherwise.
cases.expected_decision: Keep Ambrettolide in the ideal computational arm, omit it from physical-current claims, and name one controlled comparison.

cases.target_identity: A cool diffusive mineral musk tail with one clearly assigned function.
facts: Habanolide already supplies the declared cool diffusive mineral function.
Adding Romandolide is proposed only to create a two-musk stack.
No distinct target function or nonredundancy evidence is supplied for the second musk.
cases.expected_decision: Make no change; keep the single precise musk.

cases.target_identity: A deliberately dated animalic-powder musk shadow requiring an explicit Tonalide exception beneath dry woods.
facts: The target explicitly requires the dated powder shadow, so Tonalide is an allowed design exception.
Pairwise observations exist for the base versus Tonalide and the base versus dry-wood modifier.
No observation tests the joint Tonalide-by-dry-wood interaction.
A layered-synergy claim requires base, Tonalide-only, modifier-only, and joint arms at constant total.
cases.expected_decision: Hold the layered-synergy claim and design the four isolated n-ary arms.

cases.target_identity: Determine whether observed dry-wood depth rises between one minute and thirty minutes.
facts: The protocol, endpoint, schedule, sample, assessor, repeat, and presentation fields are complete and unique.
Observed depth values at 60 seconds are 2, 3, 3, and 4.
Observed depth values at 1800 seconds are 5, 5, 6, and 6.
No assessor disagreement threshold, order imbalance, or missing cell is triggered.
cases.expected_decision: Report the observed median transition and request no additional comparison because the declared question is resolved.

cases.target_identity: Summarize a balanced depth panel while preserving one absent canonical cell.
facts: The design requires 3 assessors by 2 repeats by 2 timepoints for one endpoint, for 12 canonical cells.
Exactly 11 canonical cells were observed.
The absent cell is assessor A3, repeat 2, timepoint 1800 seconds, endpoint DEPTH.
No interpolation rule was prespecified or authorized.
cases.expected_decision: Hold completeness, preserve the absent cell, and name only the missing observation as the next action.

cases.target_identity: Audit a temporal ledger containing two values for one canonical cell.
facts: Two records share protocol P1, sample X, assessor A2, repeat 1, timepoint 60, and endpoint RICHNESS.
The duplicate values are 3 and 7 and have different source row hashes.
A proposal averages them to 5 and continues the analysis.
No provenance rule establishes which record supersedes the other.
cases.expected_decision: Hold the ledger, preserve both conflicting records and their hashes, and do not average them.

cases.target_identity: Interpret liking observations from a two-sample sequence with possible first-order carryover.
facts: All six assessors received sample A first and sample B second.
The schedule declares no counterbalanced sequence and no qualified washout evidence.
Sample B has lower liking at the second position.
Order and sample identity are perfectly confounded.
cases.expected_decision: Hold directional interpretation and request a balanced schedule rather than claiming sample B is less liked.

cases.target_identity: Combine two depth ledgers only if their protocol scope and schedule lineage match exactly.
facts: Ledger one uses protocol P-DEPTH-1, endpoint DEPTH, and schedule hash H1.
Ledger two uses protocol P-RICH-2, endpoint RICHNESS, and schedule hash H2.
The proposal pools both ledgers into one depth trajectory.
No cross-endpoint calibration or protocol bridge exists.
cases.expected_decision: Hold pooling and retain the ledgers as separate scopes.

cases.target_identity: Claim a sub-second citrus-to-floral transition from an uninstrumented manual sniff.
facts: The observation sheet reports events at 0.2 and 0.6 seconds within one sniff.
No apparatus clock, airflow control, synchronized event marker, or qualified within-sniff protocol is recorded.
A volatility model predicts citrus loss over the same interval.
The proposal treats the prediction and manual timestamps as perceived transition evidence.
cases.expected_decision: Hold the within-sniff claim and require qualified apparatus and timing before admission.

cases.target_identity: Learn only the scoped depth preference from blinded, connected, order-balanced comparisons.
facts: The criterion is DEPTH; target fidelity, richness, and liking were collected separately and are not part of this fit.
Eight depth outcomes contain four A-over-B wins, two B-over-A wins, and two ties across identified assessors.
The comparison graph is connected, order is balanced, assessor-cluster bootstrap is fixed, and held-out proper score beats the declared baseline.
The B-versus-C pair has the widest interval and is the deterministic next comparison.
cases.expected_decision: Augment scoped depth evidence with tie-aware intervals and one B-versus-C next-pair recommendation.

cases.target_identity: Fit a depth preference graph only when every candidate belongs to one connected comparison component.
facts: Observed comparisons connect A with B and C with D.
No comparison links either component to the other.
The proposal reports one global utility ranking A through D.
One bridge comparison can connect the components without claiming a current global ranking.
cases.expected_decision: Hold the global fit and recommend one deterministic bridge pair between the components.

cases.target_identity: Determine liking preference when presentation position is perfectly confounded with the observed winner.
facts: Across eight blinded comparisons, the first-presented item wins all eight times.
Each product is first in only one fixed subset and no reverse-order replicate exists.
The proposal fits directional product utilities and declares the leading product more liked.
The positional effect cannot be separated from product preference.
cases.expected_decision: Hold directional liking and report the perfect first-position confound.

cases.target_identity: Preserve complete indifference evidence without inventing a directional preference.
facts: All six blinded richness comparisons between A and B are recorded as ties.
The criterion and protocol scope are exact, but there is no directional outcome.
The proposal breaks ties using formula composition and material prestige.
Composition and prestige are not observed preference evidence.
cases.expected_decision: Make no preference augmentation; preserve a tie rate of one and withhold directional utilities.

cases.target_identity: Retain a time-specific liking crossover instead of collapsing it into one overall winner.
facts: At 60 seconds, A wins liking over B in five of six balanced comparisons.
At 1800 seconds, B wins liking over A in five of six balanced comparisons.
The two timepoints were prespecified as separate scopes.
The proposal pools both scopes and reports A as the overall winner.
cases.expected_decision: Hold pooled utility, report the temporal crossover, and keep both timepoint-specific fits separate.

cases.target_identity: Validate a target-fidelity preference model only on untouched assessors and a declared baseline.
facts: The held-out assessor set was inspected repeatedly to choose bootstrap count and model settings.
After that leakage, the reported proper score is 0.65 versus a declared baseline of 0.63, where lower is better.
Intervals are narrow but come from the contaminated evaluation split.
The proposal promotes the model because the intervals look stable.
cases.expected_decision: Hold validation for both split leakage and baseline failure; stable intervals do not rescue it.
